card.name: Poor metabolizer prevalence in CYP2D6 text
card.fires_on: The space just before a percentage figure, after "about" or "approximately", when the text says what share of the Caucasian population has reduced CYP2D6 (debrisoquine hydroxylase) activity. It also fires on a few other spots in the same CYP2D6 poor-metabolizer passages.

modes.label: Space before percentage
modes.description: The space after "about" or "approximately" and before a number like 7% to 10% in CYP2D6 poor-metabolizer statements.
